messages:
Anya (Product): Quick design review — updated mock for playground streaming chat. TL;DR: try Pause vs Stop semantics, condensed token counter, and a prompt-library quick-insert preview. Mock: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/px1. Thoughts? Matt (Design): I like the condensed token pill. One thing — 'Stop' today kills the stream and drops partial tokens from the UI. Proposal: add 'Pause' that preserves partial output and lets the user resume streaming. Visually, small pill top-right of response area so it doesn't steal focus. :thought_balloon: Jamie (Eng): Runtime note: server-side resume is hard because KV cache and generation state aren't resumable mid-request for most models. We can do a client-side pause (buffer tokens, stop the request) and then re-issue a new request with the partial text as a prefix. Adds dedup/safety handling but doable as a POC. Zach (DevEx): Microcopy thoughts: users misinterpret 'Stop' frequently. Proposed labels: `Pause generation` (primary) and `Stop & keep partial` (secondary). Keyboard shortcuts: `Esc` = stop, `Ctrl+.` = cancel, `Ctrl+Enter` = regenerate. Token tooltip should read: "Tokens used so far / model limit (estimated cost)". Aria (A11y): A11y nits: live-stream updates cause VoiceOver to read every tiny update. Please avoid aria-live on the entire message stream. Instead batch updates and expose a summary region with `aria-live="polite"` that updates every N chunks. Example pattern:```html
Generating… chunk 3 of 12
```Also token pill contrast currently fails WCAG (gray text on light blue). Need >= 4.5:1 for normal text or bump to 3:1 for large text. Ensure stop/pause is focusable with a visible focus ring. Matt (Design): Uploaded variant B — changed label to `Pause (resume)` and added a small `Stop & keep` secondary button. Moved token pill to the left of the prompt drawer so it doesn't overlap message actions. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/px2 :eyes: Anya (Product): OK — Jamie, can we prototype client-side pause (buffering partial output) so product can test UX while we evaluate server-side resume complexity? Jamie (Eng): Yes. Plan: on pause, abort the inflight stream, keep client-side buffer of tokens, store a small hash of safety checks, and on resume create a new request with `prefix = buffered_text`. Need to account for irreversible tokens (e.g., truncated tokens mid-byte) and duplicate handling. Will log a `resumed_session` flag in events. Zach (DevEx): For observability, add a `partial_output` tag to events so console shows resumed vs fresh generations. Prompt-library quick-insert: show a small token-delta estimate modal before insertion so designers can see budget impact. Aria (A11y): Also ensure keyboard-only users can reach the pause/stop controls in one tab stop from the message composer. Add an accessible tooltip that announces the shortcut. Example tooltip content: `Pause generation — shortcut Esc`. Anya (Product): Action items: Matt -> update mock with revised labels and contrast fixes. Jamie -> spike client-side pause POC and telemetry. Zach -> token counter tooltip copy + token-delta on prompt insert. Aria -> add QA checklist entries for streaming batching + focus order. I'll collate and schedule a 30m sync next week. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
